name: ChronoTunes - Multiplayer Music Timeline Game
description: ChronoTunes is a browser-based multiplayer music timeline game inspired by Hitster. Players compete to place songs in chronological order while others bet on their success. The game uses YouTube for audio playback and Convex for real-time multiplayer synchronization.
